preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 2 * 10**5 for x in stdin.split())
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two integers n and k, each between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
Input contains exactly two space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(line.strip() != '' and all(1 <= int(y) <= k for y in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid coloring exists, output is exactly 'NO'. Otherwise, output starts with 'YES' followed by n lines, each containing two integers b_i and g_i between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(1 <= int(b) <= k and 1 <= int(g) <= k and b != g for b, g in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each pair (b_i, g_i), both colors are integers between 1 and k inclusive, and b_i ≠ g_i (no same-color pair).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all((b_i != b_j or g_i != g_j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) for b_i, g_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()] for b_j, g_j in [stdout.splitlines()[j + 1].split()])
postconditions.description: No two pairs (b_i, g_i) and (b_j, g_j) are identical (i ≠ j).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(b_i != b_j or g_i != g_j for i in range(n - 1) for b_i, g_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()] for b_j, g_j in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 2].split()]) and all(b_i != b_j for i in range(n - 1) for b_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()[0]] for b_j in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 2].split()[0]]) and all(g_i != g_j for i in range(n - 1) for g_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()[1]] for g_j in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 2].split()[1]])
postconditions.description: For every two consecutive pairs, the man's costume colors differ (b_i ≠ b_{i+1}) and the woman's costume colors differ (g_i ≠ g_{i+1}).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and (n == 0 or all(1 <= int(b) <= k and 1 <= int(g) <= k and b != g for b, g in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) and all((b_i != b_j or g_i != g_j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) for b_i, g_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()] for b_j, g_j in [stdout.splitlines()[j + 1].split()]) and all(b_i != b_j for i in range(n - 1) for b_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()[0]] for b_j in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 2].split()[0]]) and all(g_i != g_j for i in range(n - 1) for g_i in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 1].split()[1]] for g_j in [stdout.splitlines()[i + 2].split()[1]]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the coloring satisfies all constraints: no same-color pairs, no identical pairs, and consecutive pairs differ in both man and woman colors.
